meta_description: Frii OpenStreetMap map we wok aaflain uol taim iina di Kiwix riida. Vekta tail, satalait pikcha, 3D tarien an Wikipedia infamieshan — it wok widout intanet pan iOS, Android, Mac, Windows an Linux.
tagline: OpenStreetMap map we wok aaflain uol taim iina di Kiwix riida. Vekta tail, satalait pikcha, 3D tarien an Wikipedia — yu no niid no intanet.
badge_mac_title: Kiwix pan di Mac App Store
maps_intro: Pik wan riijan dong ya so, instaal Kiwix, an uopn di .zim fail. Di fail dem de pan di Internet Archive — evri dounluod kom wid wan torrent.
maps_intro_lang: Pik wan riijan dong ya so an dounluod it iina Patwa: di map liebl dem, di sorch an Wikipedia de iina Patwa. Uopn di fail iina Kiwix, wan frii app; evri map piej shuo yu ou fi dwiit, step bai step.
feature_key_intro: Di baj dem pan evri kyaad shuo wa de insaid:
badge_overture_desc: websait, fuon nomba an suoshal miidia fram Overture,
badge_photo_desc: fain wan plies fram a foto a wan sain.
what_lead: StreetZim pak OpenStreetMap dieta — uol konchri ar uol kantinent — iina wan ZIM fail we yu kyan uopn iina Kiwix. It wok aaflain uol taim: no sorva, no API kaal, an yu no niid no intanet afta di fos dounluod.
what_p2: Nof aaflain map app yuuz rasta tail, bot StreetZim yuuz vekta tail we jraa rait pan yu divais wid MapLibre GL JS. So di map muuv smuud wen yu jrag it, zuum it ar ton it, an yu get 3D tarien tu — aal fram wan fail pan yu divais.
feat_vector_p: Smuud, shaap map dong to chriit levl, wid di OpenMapTiles skiima, we MapLibre jraa laiv.
feat_sat_p: Sentinel-2 pikcha widout no kloud, 10 miita rezolyuushan, fi di uol riijan pan di map.
feat_terrain_p: Hil shied an 3D hait fram di Copernicus GLO-30 global DEM.
feat_wiki_p: Tap eni siti, mountin ar lanmaak fi si im Wikipedia aatikl an di mien fak dem.
feat_search_p: Sorch chuu milyan a plies niem, chriit, paak, mountin tap, ierpuot an POI.
feat_offline_p: Jos wan .zim fail. No akount, no telemichri, no netwok. Uopn it an go.
step1_p: Frii riida fi iOS, Android, Mac, Windows an Linux. Get it a kiwix.org. Pan Windows an Linux, uopn di map dem iina di Kiwix PWA fi nou: Kiwix Desktop 2.5 shuo dem blangk, an di fiks de onli iina di nightly builds so faar.
step2_p: Pik wan riijan op a tap an dounluod di .zim fail (ar tek di torrent fi get it faasa).
step2_p_lang: Pik wan riijan op a tap an pres im dounluod botn: yu get di map iina Patwa, az wan .zim fail.
step3_p: Uopn di .zim fail iina di Kiwix app. Dat a it — di map wok aaflain uol taim.
sources_intro: StreetZim mek fram uopn dieta onli. Evri map ZIM kyari kantent fram dem suos ya:
src_map: Map dieta: © OpenStreetMap kanchribiuta dem, anda di Open Database License (ODbL).
src_sat: Satalait pikcha: EOxCloudless https://cloudless.eox.at by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2021) — CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, onli fi non-komarshal yuus.
src_elev: Hait: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM — © DLR / Airbus, we di Yuropiyan Yuunyan an ESA gi anda di COPERNICUS pruogram.
src_place: Plies infamieshan: Wikidata (CC0) an Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0).
oss_intro: StreetZim dipen pan di Kiwix riida app dem fi uopn .zim fail. Evri wan a dem a uopn suos an dem bil pan GitHub:
footer: StreetZim a wan uopn suos prajek. Di suos de pan GitHub. Di map dem de pan di Internet Archive.
tier_continent: Kantinent an riijan big laik kantinent
card_preview_title: Luk pan dis map iina yu brouza, chriim fram archive.org
card_languages: Mek it iina wan neda langwij
card_languages_title: Dis map wid im liebl an Wikipedia iina wan neda langwij, put tugeda iina yu brouza
card_download_lang_title: Dis map wid im liebl, sorch an Wikipedia iina Patwa, az wan .zim fail
card_original_title: Di map jos ou it mek: plies niem iina di luokal langwij; di intafies an Wikipedia iina Ingglish
card_no_lang: It no de iina Patwa yet: dis map kom wid plies niem iina di luokal langwij an wan Ingglish intafies.
mp_meta_description: Frii aaflain map a {name} fi di Kiwix app: chriit, plies, sorch, ruut an Wikipedia, iina Patwa. It wok widout intanet pan Android, iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows an Linux.
mp_lead: Wan frii map a {name} we wok widout intanet, iina di Kiwix app.
mp_feat_search: Sorch fi chriit, adres an plies.
mp_feat_nav: Ruut fi waak, baik an jraiv, we wok out rait pan yu divais.
mp_feat_overture: Shap, restorant an ada plies wid dem websait an fuon nomba.
mp_feat_satellite: Satalait pikcha a di uol riijan.
mp_feat_wiki: Wikipedia aatikl fi siti, lanmaak an plies fi si.
mp_feat_photo: Sorch wid a foto: tek a pikcha a wan sain fi fain da plies de pan di map.
mp_dl_lang_note: Map liebl, sorch an Wikipedia iina Patwa, iina wan fail fi Kiwix.
mp_dl_original_note: Di map jos ou it mek: plies niem iina di luokal langwij; di intafies an Wikipedia iina Ingglish.
mp_dl_preview: Luk pan di map iina yu brouza fos
mp_space_note: Chek se yu divais av nof frii spies bifuo yu dounluod. Big map dounluod beta pan Wi-Fi.
kg_h2: Ou fi uopn di map iina Kiwix
kg_android_1: Instaal Kiwix fram Google Play. It frii.
kg_android_2: Dounluod di map op a tap. Yu fuon siev it iina Downloads.
kg_android_3: Uopn Kiwix, go a im laibri an ad di fail we yu dounluod.
kg_ios_1: Instaal Kiwix fram di App Store. It frii.
kg_ios_2: Dounluod di map op a tap. Safari siev it iina di Files app, anda Downloads.
kg_ios_3: Uopn Kiwix, go a im laibri an uopn di fail fram Downloads.
kg_mac_1: Instaal Kiwix fram di Mac App Store, den uopn di fail we yu dounluod wid it.
kg_pc_1: Uopn di Kiwix web app iina yu brouza an pik di fail we yu dounluod. Kiwix Desktop 2.5 shuo dem map ya blangk; di fiks de onli iina di nightly builds so faar.
kg_offline: Afta dat, di map wok widout intanet.
nav_aria: Di paat dem a dis piej
hero_apps: It uopn iina di frii Kiwix app:
tour_lead: Evriting iina dem klip ya ron fram wan fail pan di divais. Dem rikaad wid di intanet kot aaf; onli di kyapshan dem an di dat dem we maak evri tap put iin aftawod.
tour_photo_h: Tek a foto a wan sain, fain di plies
tour_photo_p: Tek a pikcha a wan chriit sain, wan shap front ar di adres pan wan hotel kii kyaad, an di map luk fi di plies we it niem. Di rait riid pan yu divais, iina di skrip we it rait iina: ya so Yuukrienian, Griik, Arabik, Japaniiz, Kuoriyan, Chainiiz an Ingglish, said bai said.
tour_photo_note: Pan di map dem we av dis baj.
tour_zoom_h: Fram di uol siti to wan bilin
tour_zoom_p: Vekta map stie shaap a evri zuum: flai fram aal a Kyiv dong to wan singl bilin, den tilt an ton di map.
tour_drive_p: Wan ruut kraas Kyiv, we wok out pan di fuon an fala ton bai ton. It rikaad wid wan pritend lokieshan; di migl a di chrip plie ten taim faasa.
tour_terrain_p: Hil shied, 3D tarien an satalait pikcha: di mountin dem uova Tehran.
tour_signs_p: Di siem sorch iina evri skrip, pan di map a di siti we di sain de.
tour_credits: Di sain foto dem, di pikcha a di giet an di satalait pikcha iina dem klip an skriinshat ya a ada piipl wok: si di kredit an laisens dem.
gallery_lead: Riil skriin fram di map dem, pan wan kompyuuta an pan wan fuon. Pik wan fi si it ful saiz, den flip chuu di res.
gal_city: Wan uol siti iina wan fail
gal_place: Plies kyaad wid foto an Wikipedia somari
gal_find: Fain kafe, shap an muo nierbai
gal_route: Wan ruut we wok out pan di fuon
gal_turns: Direkshan ton bai ton, az wan lis
gal_photo: Foto sorch a riid wan sain
gal_photo_found: Di plies we di sain niem
langs_lead: Plies niem, sorch, direkshan, Wikipedia aatikl an di map uon menyu dem, iina di langwij we yu riid. Skrip we rait fram rait to lef de de tu.
langs_step1_p: Pik it iina di lis dong ya so, ar iina di menyu a di tap a eni piej.
langs_step2_p: Pan yu langwij piej, di mien botn fi evri map dounluod di map iina da langwij de, az wan .zim fail. Dis Ingglish piej gi evri map jos ou it mek: plies niem iina di luokal langwij, di intafies an Wikipedia iina Ingglish.
langs_step2_p_lang: Pan dis piej, di mien botn fi evri map a “Dounluod iina Patwa”: di map wid im plies niem, sorch, Wikipedia an menyu iina Patwa, az wan .zim fail. We wan map no redi iina Patwa yet, im kyaad se so.
langs_step3_p: Nof map kyan mek tu iina langwij we piipl taak de so, laik Katalan fi Spien an Puotigal ar Welsh fi Britn an Aiyalan. Map iina ada langwij lis evri langwij fi evri map an put di fail tugeda iina yu brouza.
langs_demo_note: Di siem map a Kyiv iina Arabik, Hiibru, Hindi, Tai, Japaniiz an Chainiiz. Wan niem we no av no chranslieshan stie ou it rait luokal.
langs_grid_note: Di nomba a omoch map redi iina da langwij de tide.
filter_none: No map no mach dat. Chrai wan konchri, wan riijan ar wan siti.
credits_h: Foto an pikcha iina di klip an skriinshat dem
credits_intro: Di klip an skriinshat dem shuo di map dem jos ou dem tan. Di sain dem iina di foto sorch, wan foto a wan lanmaak an di satalait pikcha a ada piipl wok, we yuuz anda dem laisens ya. Di sain foto dem did krap.
